content.description: Installation of oil seal using SST tool on camshaft housing

content.text: (d) Install the oil seal in the camshaft housings.

items: Apply MP grease to the oil seal.
Using SST, install the new oil seal.

content.description: Installing camshafts into camshaft housings with O-rings

items: (a) Insert the camshafts into each camshaft housing.
(b) Install the O-rings and rear end covers.

content.description: Lash adjuster components showing SST, plunger, and check ball

items: (a) Immerse the lash adjuster into light oil.
(b) Insert SST into the plunger hole and slide the plunger up and down several times while pushing down lightly on the check ball.
(c) Repeat steps (a) and (b) when the plunger stroke is beyond about 0.5 mm (0.020 in.).
(d) Replace the lash adjuster with a new one if the plunger stroke exceeds 0.5 mm (0.020 in.) even after repeating steps (a) and (b) several times.

content.text: NOTE: Do not disassemble the lash adjuster.

content.description: Leak down test setup showing lash adjuster being tested with pressure gauge

items: (b) Using a leak down tester, apply 20 kg (44.1 lb, 196 N) of pressure to the plunger and measure its slide down speed after it has slid down about 2 mm (0.08 in.).

content.text: Leak down time: 2 — 7 seconds per 1 mm (0.04 in.)

items: (c) Make sure that the match hole on the No. 2 journal of the camshaft housing is aligned with that of the camshaft.
